title.narrative: The joint executive program of the project to operate the dialysis center in Al-Dhalea Governorate in the Republic of Yemen - Phase IV.

description.narrative: 1- Patients with acute and chronic renal failure in Al-Dhalea governorate 2- Raising the efficiency of health cadres in the governorate

A project based on providing free renal dialysis services for patients with acute and chronic renal failure to the residents of Al-Dhalea governorate in Yemen, in addition to providing meals to patients during dialysis treatment (each patient performs 13 monthly dialysis sessions for free), and the patient also receives health care from a consultant Free internal medicine kidney specialization, in addition to conducting related examinations for free. The project contains training activities for the health cadres working in the Al-Dhalea Center, in addition to providing job opportunities for them by securing monthly salaries for the workers.

Providing hemodialysis service in accordance with health standards and settling the service to alleviate the suffering of patients with renal failure and support the resilience of the health sector in Al-Dhalea Governorate, Republic of Yemen. Sub-objectives: Alleviating the suffering of renal failure patients / saving and preserving their lives by performing a hemodialysis process for them / improving performance in the center through the consulting clinic
